title: Ruoth Yesu E Motelona
author: Traditional
content:
{title: Ruoth Yesu E Motelona}

{comment: Verse 1}
Ruoth Yesu emotelona, 
Mondo adhi e polo Yesu otelona, 	   
Kaluwo yora kadhi e polo, 
Kik aluor ngang' ngang' Yesu otelona.

{comment: Verse 2}
Otelona kik abed maluor,
Ng'ama telona Yesu otelona
Kaluwo yora kadhi e polo, 
Ng'ama telona Yesu otelona.

{comment: Verse 3}
Kamudho duong' sibuor ruto, 
Ng'ama ti okonya ondiegi ochano e yo,
Kating' tienda ni mondo adhi, 
Joma riek puonja kanyo yo onge.

{comment: Verse 4}
Osechuna ni nyaka adhi, 
Ti atim ang'owa piny olil mudho.
Johoch hoya giywa ita, 
Kik aluw yorno wasigu ochano e yo.

{comment: Verse 5}
Ruoth telna irienyna, 
Kik arem e yo piny osesina.
Aring nyaka ane Yesu, 
Kik awinj weche piny osesina.

{comment: Verse 6}
Yo mane Yesu oluwo, 
Ne diny ngang' ngang', kendo ogondore.
To mago Ruodhwa ne ok odewo, 
Mesia noyoro nyaka kar hanga.

{comment: Verse 7}
Mwandu piny munenogi, 
Ok kony nga'to mwandu gin buru.
Ka chieng' mi iki kod lowo, 
Mwandu dong' oko mwandu gin buru.

{comment: Verse 8}
Ochier kogwen wasigu ringo, 
Ng'ama chom Yesu wach olo jachien.
Ogayi gaya ok anyal winjo, 
An ring kadhi Yesu otelona.
